{{Attr|Energy}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Festive Swipe}}''' - The '''Evil Elf''' stops in its place and slashes its scythe at a tower, setting towers caught in its scythe on fire for a period of time. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Evil Elf''' was an enemy that first appeared on Wave 18 in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It had a very high amount of health, a high amount of defense and walked quite fast for its health. It had one ability, ''Festive Swipe'', where it would stop moving and slash its scythe at a tower, setting it on fire. Additionally, it was immune to being frozen and immune to being stunned by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]]. All of this made it a very threatening enemy. ==Appearance== The '''Evil Elf''' was a hulking elf with pale-green skin. Its rig had lower arms and a waist. It had a dark blue shirt with white fur along the sleeves, as well as stitch lines on the sides of the arms. It had a black line going down the middle of its torso and waist, as well as down the sides of its sleeves. It also had black stains on its torso and upper arms. It had dark navy pants and black shoes. It also wore a dark blue Christmas hat. It wielded a red and white striped candy cane themed scythe. On the end opposite of the blade are six holly leaves. The blade itself is a yellow and red striped piece of metal wedged into the bottom of the candy cane. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Engineer]] are recommended against this enemy. **These towers should have their firerate and range boosted by the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] respectively. **The [[Ranger]] cannot be stunned by the '''Evil Elf''', nor can the [[Engineer]]'s sentries be destroyed by it, making them both very effective. *The [[Medic]] can be used to cleanse the stuns from towers stunned by the '''Evil Elf's''' ''Festive Swipe'' ability. *Slowing towers can be useful in delaying the '''Evil Elf's''' advance. **The [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] cannot slow the '''Evil Elf''' down due to its [[Freeze Immunity]]. **The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] are less effective against the '''Evil Elf''' due to its [[Energy Immunity]], only being able to slow it down as opposed to stunning it. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] can be used at its maximum potential, slowing the '''Evil Elf''' down by 25%. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] can be used to reduce the '''Evil Elf's''' defense. *As the '''Evil Elf''' stops moving to use its ability, you could use cheap towers like the [[Scout]] to distract the '''Evil Elf''', causing it to use its ability on the tower, stopping it from moving and buying more time to defeat it. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Evil Elf''' added. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **'''Evil Elf''' removed. {{ColdAmbush|[[Bomber Elf (Cold Ambush)|Bomber Elf]]|Wave 16|Evil Elf|Wave 18|[[Builder Elf (Cold Ambush)|Builder Elf]]|Wave 19}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Evil Elf}}
